title: Uniform mass upper bound for all delta in (0,1/4] (parent step 1a)
statement: Let n >= 1, l >= 0, p > n. There is C_0 > 0 depending only on n, l and p (the proof gives dependence on n and p only) such that: if U is open in R^(n+l), V is a RectifiableVarifold n l U, H : R^(n+l) -> R^(n+l), 0 < delta <= 1/4 and AllardHypotheses H p delta rho hold, then mu(B_s(y)) <= C_0 omega_n s^n for every y with |y| <= rho/4 and every s in (0, rho/2].
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ p : ℝ, (n : ℝ) < p → ∃ C₀ : ℝ, 0 < C₀ ∧ ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (δ ρ : ℝ), 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 / 4 → V.AllardHypotheses H p δ ρ → ∀ y : Amb n ℓ, ‖y‖ ≤ ρ / 4 → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ ρ / 2 → V.weight (closedBall y s) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C₀ * (unitBallVolume n * s ^ n))
